description: Nokker Lokkal in VS Code: a coding session on the open folder, against the kernel of your machine.
untrusted: Nokker acts on the files of the folder: it requires a trusted folder.
welcome.changes: The files written in the last turn appear here: open the diff, then accept or refuse each file (refusing restores it from the restore point the kernel took before the turn).
welcome.sessions:
The coding sessions of your local kernel appear here.
[Refresh](command:nokker.refreshSessions)
cmd.addFile: Add a file to the message (@)
cmd.addProblems: Add the problems of this file
config.serverUrl: Address of the local kernel. Empty: `api_url` from `~/.config/nokker/lokkal.json` (written by the installer), otherwise `http://127.0.0.1:8742`. The local token is never a setting: it is read where the `nokker` CLI reads it.
config.liveWrite: While the model writes a file (`write_file`, `patch`), show what it proposes in a read-only editor next to the current one. Nothing is written to disk before the tool runs.
